reports.title: Schneider National, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section:
(in millions, except per share data) | Current Guidance
Adjusted diluted earnings per share | $1.00 - $1.10
Net capital expenditures | $325-$350

“Third quarter results underpin the progress we are making to structurally improve the business and position Schneider to generate stronger earnings as freight market conditions improve,” said Darrell Campbell, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Schneider. “As a result, the enterprise was able to deliver 66% growth in adjusted income from operations.”

“Based on our year-to-date performance and expectations for the remainder of the year, we are raising our full-year adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance to $1.00 to $1.10 and now expect net capital expenditures to be in a range of $325 million to $350 million,” Campbell added. “Our outlook anticipates continued contract rate recovery and further benefits from our productivity and cost initiatives, while also recognizing that peak season demand and driver capacity remain important variables as we close the year. The guidance assumes a full year effective tax rate of approximately 22%.”
